name: hero
facts: Each cycle runs exactly one security-audit into run-N under the engagement directory
A finding counts as new only if its root_cause plus title key is not already in ledger.md's accumulated list
The convergence counter increments on a cycle that adds zero new medium-or-higher findings, and resets otherwise
The loop stops at two consecutive zero-new cycles, or when the run number reaches max_cycles
The consolidated report is written once, at the stop, merging every run into one HTML file that stays filterable by run
Every claim in the report traces to that run's findings.json, and the report is built from the bundled assets/template.html
